title: Zameer
desc: Maharaj Singh is a proud owner of several derby-winning stallions. One day dacoits attack his farmhouse with a view of stealing these stallions, but Maharaj fights them, killing the son of the leader.

title: Raiszaada
desc: When Sanjay, a policeman, arrests Jagannath, a gangster, his senior disagrees and frees the goon. Sanjay decides to resign and fight corruption on his own.

title: Param Dharam
desc: Savitri believes that her illegitimate child with her deceased lover, Vijay, was stillborn and did not survive. Years later, Savitri's world changes when she learns that her firstborn is alive.
